title: Qantas layoffs: Australian airline to cut 850 jobs, shift work to India in AI overhaul
description: Qantas is preparing to eliminate 850 jobs in Australia as part of a technology overhaul involving Accenture, with some corporate functions moving to teams based largely in India. The decision adds to a growing list of Australian companies restructuring their workforces amid rising investment in AI and automation.

title: Canva layoffs: Is the company preparing to cut jobs again in November?
description: Canva employees are reportedly bracing for possible redundancies or a company-wide recruitment pause in November, as the design platform recalibrates its growth targets and steps up investment in artificial intelligence. The uncertainty follows earlier job cuts and comes as the company reworks its AI strategy amid intensifying competition.

title: How Many Employees Has Amazon Laid Off This Year?
description: Amazon has cut about 250 jobs in its devices and services unit, adding to a year-long of layoffs. Reports put the publicly disclosed 2026 total at roughly 17,250 roles, though the figure is a floor because Amazon does not publish a running total. The cuts come as Amazon pushes employees to use AI and restructure management layers across the company.
